name: Southwest Minnesota State University
description:
Southwest Minnesota State University is a public university in Marshall, Minnesota. It is part of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities System. It attracts approximately 232 international students from over 27 countries annually.

The University has approximately 8,700 students and employs 148 faculty members.

Student Life

The campus of Southwest Minnesota State University is lively and varied as students have registered over 70 student clubs that range from cultural organisations to social justice collectives. Students can access the Success Center to find support services ranging from mental health to career help. The fitness center on campus has cardio and weight equipment, a rock climbing wall, and a pool. There are also intramural sports and outdoor recreation opportunities.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Southwest Minnesota State University guarantees on-campus housing for all first-year students who apply for on-campus accommodation by the priority deadline. The University offers fully furnished accommodation with high-speed internet and houses three traditional residence halls on campus: Birch, Sweetland, and Individualized Learning Center (ILC).

Each hall offers double and single rooms with shared bathrooms. There are also two suite-style residence halls - McFarland and Sisq, which have a common area for each suite and the choice to live with three or five students. SMSU has two apartment-style housing options - Mustang Village and SMSU Apartments.
